basic.name: Storm Bolt
basic.description:
Throw a hammer, dealing 110~~0.04~~ damage to the first enemy hit and Stunning them for 1.25 seconds

Quest: Basic Attack Heroes affected by Stuns, Slows, or Roots. Slowed or Rooted enemies grant 1 stack. Stunned enemies provide 2 stacks.  If the Hero dies within 3 seconds, gain 5 stacks.

Reward: Upon hitting 45 targets, Storm Bolt pierces to hit an additional target, and Muradin's Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Storm Bolt by 0.5 seconds and restore 3 Mana.
Mythic Reward: Upon hitting 160 targets, Storm Bolt's range is increased by 50%, width increased by 100%, and now pierces all targets.

basic.name: Pinning Shot
basic.description: Deal 100~~0.04~~ damage to an enemy and Slow them by 40% for 2.25 seconds.

basic.name: Entangling Roots
basic.description: Root enemy Heroes in an area for 1.25 seconds, and deal 117~~0.04~~ damage over the duration. Affected area grows over 3 seconds.

heroic.name: Twilight Dream
heroic.description: After 0.5 seconds, deal 310~~0.04~~ damage in a large area around Malfurion, Silencing enemies making them unable to use Abilities for 3 seconds.

trait.name: Blinding Wind
trait.description: Throw a cloud of wind at the 2 nearest enemies (prioritizing Heroes), dealing 133~~0.04~~ damage. Heroes hit are Blinded and Slowed by 15% for 1.5 seconds.

mount.name: Polymorph
mount.description: Polymorph a target for 1.5 seconds, Slowing their Movement Speed by 30% and Silencing them. Targets are not able to attack while Polymorphed.

activable.name: Hook
activable.description:
Pull the first enemy hit towards Stitches and deal 91~~0.04~~ damage.

After reaching level 13, Hook's range is increased by 40%.
